# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 23 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 35 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_023_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 23

**1** Jesus said: "I will choose you, one out of a thousand [шо] and two out of ten thousand [тва], and they will stand as a single one [оуа оуоот]."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *шо*: a thousand; *тва*: ten thousand
- *оуа оуоот*: a single one; the recurring Thomas term (cf. Sayings 4, 11, 16, 22)
- The extreme selectivity: 1 from 1,000; 2 from 10,000
- The chosen ones "will stand as a single one" — despite being chosen as two (or three total), they become one
- *Sotē* (to choose/elect) recurs as a key verb in Thomas
- The numbers evoke the traditional tropes of Israel's remnant theology (cf. Amos 5:3) but radicalize them
- This is the most exclusive selectivity in the collection
